name: Aumovio SE
summary: Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, Aumovio SE is a global provider of cutting-edge mobility solutions. The company specializes in the design, production, and distribution of both hardware and software, serving markets across Germany, Europe, North America, the Asia-Pacific region, and beyond. Its extensive offerings include pioneering advancements in software-defined and electric mobility, sophisticated vehicle electrical and electronic architectures, state-of-the-art safety systems, advanced driver assistance technologies, and improved user experience functionalities, as well as a variety of ready-to-deploy solutions. Aumovio SE further provides expert services such as safety engineering, custom build-to-print manufacturing, and virtualization. Additionally, the company actively participates in the sales of original automotive equipment and industrial/replacement components.
